NHL Player Impact

On-ice value measured two ways: skaters by xG-RAPM (expected-goals regularized adjusted plus-minus, per 60 minutes of 5-on-5) and goalies by GSAx (goals saved above expected). These are measurements of what happened, not forward projections. Ridge strength α and minute floors shown per view; full definitions below.

Read these as measurements, with a Stage-2 caveat. Single-season xG-RAPM still over-credits a player for strong linemates (Stage 3 pools multiple seasons with a box-score prior to fix this), and goaltending is volatile in small samples — a high GSAx over 20 games is mostly noise. All skater numbers are 5-on-5 even strength only (special teams excluded), floored at the minutes shown. Nothing here is aged, shrunk, or turned into a team projection yet — that is Stage 3+.
